notes: Job READXREF step STEP05: CBACT03C reads CardDemo's card / customer / account cross reference (the CARDXREF KSDS, cardxref.txt; its 36-byte lines padded to the 50-byte record) in key order and DISPLAYs each CARD-XREF-RECORD on SYSOUT; it writes no file, so SYSOUT, RETURN-CODE and the abend are the outputs compared. Every record is DISPLAYed TWICE -- once in 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT on status '00' and again in the main loop (the program's defect: CBACT02C has the first DISPLAY commented out). Every input is the corpus's data. Derived from CardDemo (Apache-2.0; Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates): LICENSE and NOTICE here are the source's own.

faults.name: open-xreffile
faults.why: 35: OPEN of a file that is not present (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 'ERROR OPENING XREFFILE' from 0000-XREFFILE-OPEN, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: open-xreffile-verified
faults.why: 97: OPEN successful, file integrity verified (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) -- a SUCCESSFUL open, but 0000-XREFFILE-OPEN accepts only '00', so the step abends (the program's defect) through 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's 9 arm, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: xreffile-read-error
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) on the third cross reference: 'ERROR READING ...' from 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT after two cross references are displayed, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: xreffile-early-end
faults.why: 10: end of file (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) after two cross references: END-OF-FILE is set, the file is closed and the step ends normally with what it has displayed

faults.name: xreffile-status-9
faults.why: 9x: implementor-defined condition (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 1000-XREFFILE-GET-NEXT -> 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's non-numeric / 9 arm, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: close-xreffile
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) closing XREFFILE after every record is displayed: 'ERROR CLOSING ...' from 9000-XREFFILE-CLOSE, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999
